narrative: On the board. The same leaf. The light on it is lower. No candle is lit. The question is still the last line but one. On the board. Both hands on the chair, not on the paper. The leaf lies as it was. On the board. The leaf is still a full sheet, not creased down. The cloak is on the peg by the door.
